title: Fix flaky tests in notification-service
description:
Notification-service CI has been failing intermittently on timing-dependent tests in tests/test_email.py around async email delivery.

Tests failing intermittently:
- test_email_delivery_confirmation
- test_concurrent_sends
- test_retry_backoff_timing

These block the notification-service pipeline roughly once per day, requiring manual re-runs. Investigate and fix at the root cause.
scope: Fix timing-dependent tests in notification-service test suite
